== Title ==
<span lang="ja">タイ・ヴァンガード</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">能力値1の専属パイロットが搭乗している。同じ星系で敵が戦闘を宣言した際、“リアクション”としてその星系にカードを配備できる。配備コストは通常どおりに支払う。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">偵察用戦闘機。しばしば作戦の最初に投入され、全艦隊が戦闘状態に入る前に、敵艦隊の動向に関する詳細な情報を集める。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[TIE Vanguard]].

'''Lore''' — A reconnaissance starfighter. It is often sent in first to gather detailed information on enemy fleet movement before the whole fleet enters combat.

'''Game text''' — A permanent pilot of ability 1 is aboard. When the opponent initiates a battle at the same system, you may deploy cards to that system as a reaction. Pay the deploy cost as usual.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Printed subtype is 宇宙戦闘機：ＴＩＥ／ＲＣ. Stats print ハイパードライブ未装備. Lore says 敵艦隊 (enemy fleet) where English says enemy starship movement. Game text uses “リアクション” and 配備コストは通常どおりに支払う where English says 'react' and at normal use of the Force.<ref>[[:File:ANH-D-tievanguard-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[TIE Vanguard]].</ref>
